name: Media melt
doc: The picture dissolves in its own feedback: a slow noise flow and its edges (core-media's edges, turned to run along the contours) smear it like dye in water, a reaction term sharpens the smears into Turing-like worms and spots, and the live picture seeps back in, brightest areas first, snapping back on every beat so it always resurfaces; the bass speeds the flow and the palette tints what has melted.

palette.doc: the tint of the melted parts

flow.doc: speed of the noise flow (dye in water)

scale.doc: size of the flow's eddies (higher = smaller)

along.doc: push from the edges: 0 across the contours, ±1 along them

react.doc: reaction: sharpen the smears into worms and spots

resurface.doc: how fast the live picture seeps back in

beat.doc: the picture snaps back on the beat

tint.doc: palette colour bleeding into the melted parts
